proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b c hab hbc
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have e : (a + b + c) - a = b + c := by abel
    rw [e, real_inner_add_sub_eq_zero_iff]
    exact hbc
  · have e : (a + b + c) - b = c + a := by abel
    rw [e, real_inner_add_sub_eq_zero_iff]
    exact (hab.trans hbc).symm
  · have e : (a + b + c) - c = a + b := by abel
    rw [e, real_inner_add_sub_eq_zero_iff]
    exact hab
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b c : V), ‖a‖ = ‖b‖ → ‖b‖ = ‖c‖ → inner ℝ ((a + b + c) - a) (b - c) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ ((a + b + c) - b) (c - a) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ ((a + b + c) - c) (a - b) = 0
